notes: The physics of the problem text, the LaTeX equation f_A = 1/(2 pi sqrt(L_A C_A)), the parameters (L in H, C in F, target in Hz) and the certified answer 159.155 Hz all agree with my pass-1 solution (159.15 Hz).
